# Cingulate consent requester contract and vectors

Copied verbatim from the Cingulate repository at commit
`5f32467eff9f079798d30d161cb45e474d64a63a` (tag `manifest-binding-v1`), so plexus's tests and CI read the
same bytes Cingulate serves without needing a Cingulate checkout.

Relative links inside the copied contracts and vector READMEs refer to the
`cortexkit/cingulate` repository's layout at commit
`5f32467eff9f079798d30d161cb45e474d64a63a`, not to this fixture tree. The source
repository is private; the links are kept unchanged to preserve byte-identity.

- `contracts/consent-requester-v1.md` and `contracts/consent-requester-v2.md`:
  `docs/contracts/` in that commit. The requester operations plexus uses to
  file approval cards (`consent.request`, `consent.await`, `consent.get`,
  `consent.withdraw`, `consent.detach`, `consent.report_execution`), their
  bodies and refusal codes.
- `vectors/consent-requester-v1/`, `vectors/consent-requester-v2/` and
  `vectors/consent-late-answer-v1/` and `vectors/manifest-binding-v1/`: `test-vectors/` in that commit. Each
  directory's `SHA256SUMS` was generated by Cingulate from its handler replies;
  every file passed `shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS` when copied.

Do not edit these files. To move to a newer contract, copy the new commit's
files over these, rerun the checksum check, and update the commit above.

The `plexus-request.json` vector is a generic-consent admission and wire example,
not Plexus's fixed approval prompt. Plexus files service/action cards with
`requester_ref`, carrier/call-key `dedup_key` and a redacted argument preview.
Identity still comes only from the daemon's route stamp. Plexus opens each
card's route under the agent's session scope, and the module that owns that
scope (prefrontal-core, for heads and workers) must list `reserved:plexus` as
a carrier allowed to open routes to `cingulate`. Cingulate admitting plexus as
a requester does not replace that route permission.

Manifest-binding cards are separate: Plexus files the vault statement verbatim
on its own unscoped route, with no authored text or expiry override. The file
`vectors/manifest-binding-v1/SHA256SUMS` hashes to
`e2e453876167a4f192be76c0a5768c0ae51333b3306d69ed514d92390157f35c`.
